response.original_title: La pequeña banda de la justicia
response.overview: Montevideo, 1983. When her best friend's family suddenly flees under suspicious circumstances, taking her away with them, 10-year-old Lucía gathers her gang to launch a plan inspired by their favorite superheroes. Together, they create clever comic strips that cover the neighborhood walls in hopes of bringing her back and unexpectedly begin transforming the harsh reality surrounding them.
